scope: Selected meanings and bounded claims of nine identified manuscripts, six foundation units and 25 roadmap definitions; not exhaustive semantic extraction.
snapshot_policy: Each document uses its own immutable source pin. Proposal pins are not a coherent accepted release. Rebase or merge requires a fresh graph snapshot and review of changed endpoints.

terms.label: Knowledge Contract
terms.reading_summary: A versioned specification of knowledge, intended use, grounds, dependencies, constraints and assessment obligations; not truth or execution authority.

terms.label: Semantic object
terms.reading_summary: An addressable, versioned interpretation with content, attribution, context and grounds; not necessarily a retrieval chunk.

terms.label: Interpretation
terms.reading_summary: A reading under stated assumptions; several readings can remain possible.

terms.label: Context
terms.reading_summary: Conditions needed to interpret or use content, including relevant referents, scope, time, exceptions and recipient.

terms.label: Constraint
terms.reading_summary: A condition restricting admissible interpretation, transformation, delivery or action; distinct from an acceptance criterion.

terms.label: Protected property
terms.reading_summary: An observation or relation that a transformation is required to preserve.

terms.label: Coverage
terms.reading_summary: Established support for required slots of a named request at a named stage; not keyword presence.

terms.label: Dependency closure
terms.reading_summary: The least set containing selected roots and their active mandatory dependencies in a declared graph; it does not discover omitted edges.

terms.label: Assessment
terms.reading_summary: A method-bound judgment about a particular subject revision and property.

terms.label: Authority
terms.reading_summary: The legitimate scope of decisions or actions supplied by an identified authorization basis.

terms.label: Revision
terms.reading_summary: An immutable identified content state; distinct from the mutable current selection.

terms.label: Evidence
terms.reading_summary: An addressed observation or record supporting a specified claim under a method and trust boundary.

terms.label: Work Item
terms.reading_summary: One goal-bearing unit with versioned requirements, constraints, assignments, attempts and acceptance criteria.

terms.label: Skill
terms.reading_summary: A reusable description of a method and its conditions; the file is not evidence that its reader can perform it.

terms.label: Admission
terms.reading_summary: A decision permitting a particular use under specified requirements, policy and trust boundary.

terms.label: Knowledge utility
terms.reading_summary: Task-, policy- and horizon-dependent benefit relative to a stated baseline and cost model; not an intrinsic document score.

claims.plain_meaning: The paper supplies sufficient conditions under which prepared knowledge is admitted for a new use; prior completion alone does not supply that justification.
premises: Complete unchanged relevant state and request observations
claims.limits: Not a necessary characterization of every possible justification; not automatic dependency discovery, existence of an output or runtime enforcement.

claims.plain_meaning: Applicability belongs to a specified use and its conditions, not to a context-free label of validity.
premises: Mandatory conditions discharged, including a justified exemption when applicable
claims.limits: Unknown mandatory conditions do not become pass; a source statement is not automatically an endorsement or grant.

claims.plain_meaning: For successful finite chains starting in the first precondition P1(x0), compatible step conditions and agreed intermediate observations provide sufficient grounds for endpoint preservation.
premises: The initial state x0 satisfies the first local precondition P1(x0)
Each local contract preserves its declared observation
Adjacent observation functions agree on the relevant intermediate states
claims.limits: No termination or output-existence guarantee; failure of a premise blocks this proof, not necessarily every individual successful path.

claims.plain_meaning: Selecting a dependency-complete set does not establish that the necessary conditions survived in the delivered context.
premises: Complete relevant dependencies in the selected model
Preservation or re-establishment in the actual delivered representation
claims.limits: A closed graph is not a semantic delivery test; the finite selection models are not production KC conformance.

claims.plain_meaning: An earlier requirement generation cannot become current solely because its old completion event arrives late.
premises: Work Item and non-reissued generation identities
Comparison at the same serialization point as making the result current
Otherwise a new assessment bound to the actual output and active generation
claims.limits: Not interpretation correctness or selection among same-generation attempts; internal atomic replay handling is not external exactly-once execution.

claims.plain_meaning: A finite acyclic derivation preserves truth when its premises, rules and side conditions satisfy the stated semantics.
claims.limits: A graph-shaped explanation does not establish these premises, semantic extraction or implementation compliance.

claims.source_location: Proposition 3. Complete dependencies identify candidates for reassessment
claims.plain_meaning: Reverse reachability finds all potentially affected assessments only relative to a complete represented dependency graph.
claims.limits: Affected does not mean false; alternative sufficient grounds can remain, and an omitted edge defeats completeness.

claims.source_location: Proposition 2. A simple reuse policy has a conditional break-even point
claims.plain_meaning: In the restricted accounting model, reuse costs less exactly when its preparation and all admitted-hit costs are below the valid cold-route cost.
premises: Nonnegative costs in one unit and horizon
No intervening invalidation or additional omitted cost
claims.limits: Not measured savings, causal benefit, universally fair allocation or permission to skip checks.

claims.plain_meaning: A representation is assessed against declared task-relevant distinctions rather than identified with all human meaning.
premises: Nonempty and justified operational assessment domain
claims.limits: Set-theoretic factorization is not an effective decoder, universal human semantics or evidence of extraction accuracy.

preparation_order_semantics: Default author-directed manuscript preparation; not a runtime dependency. Later explicit per-document instructions and existing independent authorized work retain their scope.
baseline_pilot_boundary: RM-18 is the advanced research extension. Its geometry and hybrid-retrieval prerequisites are not new prerequisites for the separately authorized baseline Live Lab or KB-CONS-01.

relation_kinds.uses-term: Reading crosswalk to a shared term, not a claim of identical implementation semantics.
relation_kinds.states-bounded-claim: Identifies an authored summary and its premises; the source argument remains authoritative.
relation_kinds.has-candidate: A complete candidate exists at the pinned path; not scientific or publication acceptance.
relation_kinds.extends-existing-path: Planned work develops an existing manuscript; the current editorial revision does not complete the plan.
relation_kinds.addresses-planned-scope: A manuscript unit covers topics of an RM definition; not completion or a whole-task alias.
relation_kinds.informs-not-blocks: Advisory relation from the roadmap, not a start gate.
relation_kinds.reading-interface: Source-grounded conceptual cross-reference; may form cycles and is not an inference rule.
relation_kinds.claim-has-ground: Descriptive traceability from a claim revision to an assessment; not a truth verdict.
relation_kinds.ground-uses-source: Descriptive traceability from an assessment to an external source record; not endorsement.

retained_source_map.semantics: Retained exact section-level F01 map. This new view references it rather than replacing its 18 independently reviewable statements.

required_output_semantics: Only roadmap_nodes.requires carries the 45 existing requires_output edges. These are proposal definitions, not observed Muneral readiness. Reading links never become execution prerequisites automatically.
provenance: Original KC-Brain reading synthesis at the author's request; definitions and bounded arguments are attributed to the pinned project sources. No external-book payload or new empirical result.
